question: At 1 THz, what refractive index and real permittivity did the Sn24W-GST film annealed at 250 °C have?
rendered:
According to the document, the dielectric properties of the Sn24W-GST film annealed at 250 °C at 1 THz are:

- Refractive index (n): 49.43
- Real permittivity (ε′): 2432.49
